label: Ordo Exsequiarum — Ad processionem ad cœmeterium

chants.notes: Antiphon I of 'Ad processionem ad coemeterium' (p698-702), with Psalmus 117 (verses continue onto p699). Resolves to gregobase 15642, which gregobase holds only as a Graduale Simplex 1975 p403 INTROIT (office-part 'in') though the GR uses it as an antiphon. This needed an office_part:'in' override until 2026-09-16, when gr_index_entry row 798 was curated to that id; the curated index now reaches it directly and the override was removed.

Antiphon II, with Psalmus 117 (same psalm as antiphon I). Printed rubric under the psalm block: 'Alii versiculi ut supra.' — i.e. reuses antiphon I's Ps 117 verses (not a Vel:/alternate marker, so not option_txt).
Antiphon III, with Psalmus 41 (verses continue onto p700 below).
Antiphon IV, with Psalmus 24 (verses continue onto p702 above antiphon V).
Antiphon V, with Psalmus 15 (verses continue below to the end of p702).
